```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '**/*.rs'
      - '**/*.ts'
      - '**/*.tsx'
      - '**/*.js'
      - '**/*.json'
      - '**/*.md'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'justfile'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**/*.rs'
      - '**/*.ts'
      - '**/*.tsx'
      - '**/*.js'
      - '**/*.json'
      - '**/*.md'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'justfile'

jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Set up pnpm caching
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21
        with:
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          scope: '@oxc-project'
          architecture: 'x64'
          cpu: 'x64'

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: moonrepo/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          channel: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy
          cache: true

      - name: Install system utilities
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y tree jq

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Rust dependencies
        run: cargo fetch

      - name: Generate Rust documentation
        run: |
          cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items
        env:
          RUSTDOCFLAGS: "-Zunstable-options --enable-index-page"

      - name: Extract TypeScript definitions
        run: |
          pnpm exec tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir types
        # If a build script exists, replace the above line with:
        # pnpm run build:types

      - name: Analyze code structure
        run: |
          mkdir -p structure
          tree -J src > structure/src.json
          tree -J lib > structure/lib.json
          tree -J tests > structure/tests.json
          echo '{}' > structure/structure.json

      - name: Extract configuration
        run: |
          mkdir -p config
          cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps | jq '{name, version, authors, dependencies}' > config/cargo.json
          jq '{name, version, dependencies, devDependencies}' package.json > config/package.json

      - name: Map test architecture
        run: |
          mkdir -p tests
          find . -type f -name '*_test.rs' -o -name '*test.ts' -o -name '*test.js' > tests/test_files.txt
          echo '{}' > tests/test_map.json

      - name: Validate AGENTS.md
        run: |
          REQUIRED_SECTIONS=(
            "## Project Overview"
            "## Development Workflow"
            "## Code Conventions"
            "## Testing Strategy"
            "## Common Patterns"
            "## Performance Considerations"
            "## Debugging"
          )
          MISSING=()
          for section in "${REQUIRED_SECTIONS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "$section" AGENTS.md; then
              MISSING+=("$section")
            fi
          done
          if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Missing sections in AGENTS.md:" >&2
            printf '%s\n' "${MISSING[@]}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Upload Rust docs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rust-docs
          path: target/doc

      - name: Upload TypeScript definitions
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ts-definitions
          path: types

      - name: Upload code structure
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: code-structure
          path: structure

      - name: Upload configuration summary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: config-summary
          path: config

      - name: Upload test map
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-map
          path: tests

      - name: Upload AGENTS.md
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: agents-md
          path: AGENTS.md

      - name: Package AI context bundle
        run: |
          mkdir -p ai-context
          cp -r target/doc ai-context/rust-docs
          cp -r types ai-context/ts-definitions
          cp -r structure ai-context/code-structure
          cp -r config ai-context/config-summary
          cp -r tests ai-context/test-map
          cp AGENTS.md ai-context/AGENTS.md
          tar -czf ai-context.tar.gz ai-context

      - name: Upload AI context bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: copilot-context-bundle
          path: ai-context.tar.gz
```
